const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys

root = pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools'))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

baseline_commit = 'a415a68c2200ebd070af816723bce72bd0b0051b'
expected_sources = {
    'mod-tome.lua': {
        '"Won" ToME by sacrificing yourself for your patron Distant Sun, opening a portal for it to burn and consume the world.',
        'Won ToME by closing the Void portal and letting yourself be killed by Aeryn to prevent your mad patron sun from burning the world in a searing flash.',
        'Though you succumbed to the fight, your mind was already gone, burnt to ashes by your mad patron sun. But the world was saved.',
    },
    'tome-orcs.lua': {'sunwall observatory'},
}
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest(version='tome-1.7.6', manifest_path=None)))
changes = []
file_summaries = {}
conv = re.compile(r'%(?:[-+#0]*[0-9]*(?:\.[0-9]+)?[diouxXeEfFgGcsq]|%)')
markup = re.compile(r'#\{[a-z]+\}#|#[A-Z_]+#|<\?=.*?\?>|@[A-Za-z0-9_]+@')
for name, wanted_sources in expected_sources.items():
    before_bytes = subprocess.run(
        ['git', 'show', f'{baseline_commit}:{name}'], cwd=root,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=True,
    ).stdout
    after_bytes = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert b'\r' not in before_bytes and b'\r' not in after_bytes, name
    assert before_bytes.count(b'\n') == after_bytes.count(b'\n'), name
    before = loader.load_bytes(before_bytes, logical_path=name).records
    after = loader.load_bytes(after_bytes, logical_path=name).records
    assert len(before) == len(after), (name, len(before), len(after))
    changed_sources = set()
    for index, (old, new) in enumerate(zip(before, after)):
        if old == new:
            continue
        differing = sorted(key for key in set(old) | set(new) if old.get(key) != new.get(key))
        assert differing == ['target'], (name, index, differing)
        assert old['kind'] == 'translation' and new['kind'] == 'translation'
        assert conv.findall(old['target']) == conv.findall(new['target']), (name, old['source'], 'placeholder')
        assert markup.findall(old['target']) == markup.findall(new['target']), (name, old['source'], 'markup')
        assert old['target'].count('\n') == new['target'].count('\n'), (name, old['source'], 'newline')
        assert old['target'].count('\t') == new['target'].count('\t'), (name, old['source'], 'tab')
        changed_sources.add(old['source'])
        changes.append({
            'file': name,
            'source': old['source'],
            'before': old['target'],
            'after': new['target'],
            'unchanged_fields': ['source', 'source_tag', 'args_order', 'special', 'section', 'line', 'function_name'],
        })
    assert changed_sources == wanted_sources, (name, changed_sources ^ wanted_sources)
    file_summaries[name] = {
        'records_before': len(before),
        'records_after': len(after),
        'changed_targets': len(changed_sources),
        'lf_count_unchanged': True,
        'no_cr': True,
    }
assert len(changes) == 4, len(changes)
print(json.dumps({'status': 'pass', 'baseline_commit': baseline_commit, 'changed_targets': len(changes), 'files': file_summaries, 'changes': changes}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
